description: Headset A/B scenario, run with --env LB_MAX_FPS=120 so frame time shows the game's cost instead of the 60 fps cap (the build installed before 2026-11-10 logs no work column). coc whiterunorigin, stand (idle), run up the street (run). Frame numbers assume up to 120 fps: menu by 1800, city loaded by 6000.
